text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING — High tail latency detected on preproc/tokenizer pipeline (service: preproc-worker-2) — p95=420ms p99=2.8s; increased error-rate on streaming endpoints. Auto-escalation triggered.

oncall-alex: on it. grabbing logs and looking at recent deploys.

eng-ml-sam: echoing — I saw a small config push to prompt-template v2 a few minutes ago, could be related. also seeing spikes correlate with large JSON-mode tool-schema payloads.

ingest-rita: confirmed: traffic heatmap shows concentrated traffic from a handful of customers starting ~3654321900. size distribution shifted — median prompt size up 3.5x, 95th skewed by JSON-mode requests.

ops-ian: which customers? need to check SLA impact and open support tickets if streaming stalls hit customers.

product-maya: @ops-ian list of impacted customers in support queue 1347 and 1348, both on dedicated. Customer support already flagged streaming stall reports.

oncall-alex: quick triage notes:
- observed GC spikes on preproc-worker-2 (heap churn)
- tokenizer CPU up 78% on node pool-a
- prefix cache miss rate increased around same time

eng-ml-sam: digging into traces — tail time dominated by prompt construction step, specifically template expansion + tool-schema flattening in JSON mode. large nested schemas blow up tokenization time. Example payload snippet:

```json
{
  "mode": "json",
  "tools": [{"name":"extractor","schema": {"fields": [...many nested objects...] }}, ...]
}
```

ingest-rita: logs show repeated retokenize loops for long templates:

```
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z preproc-worker-2 tokenizer.cpp:312 retokenize loop start size=16384
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z preproc-worker-2 prompt_builder.cpp:88 expanding tool schema -> tokens=2400
2026-03-15T10:12:35Z preproc-worker-2 tokenizer.cpp:340 long-run > 1500ms
```

eng-ml-sam: hypothesis: new template v2 introduced optional schema inlining which duplicates large sections per tool instance; combined with JSON-mode we are hitting pathological tokenization work and memory churn.

oncall-alex: mitigation plan (short-term):
1) add a routing rule to send JSON-mode requests > 8k chars to fallthrough model variant (lower-cost CPU path) — reduces pressure on preproc-worker-2.
2) scale preproc-worker pool by +2 nodes and bump node type for tokenizer threads.
3) temporarily disable inlining in prompt-template service (rollback flag).

ops-ian: executing 1 and 2 now. routing rule pushed to traffic-gateway: `route: if header.x-prompt-mode==json and len>8192 -> fallback-json-pool`

product-maya: notifying the two impacted customers with a brief: "we're seeing transient streaming stalls due to large JSON templates; routing mitigation in place, expecting improvement within 5-10 minutes."

eng-ml-sam: pushed feature-flag `template.inline_schema=false` for prompt-template v2; that should prevent per-request expansion. watching for effect.

ingest-rita: after routing change + flag, p95 dropped from 420ms to 160ms and p99 from 2.8s to 380ms on preproc-worker-2 within 4 minutes. streaming error-rate dropped to baseline.

oncall-alex: good. keeping oncall until stable for 30m. need a postmortem: root cause looks like template inline change + traffic shift -> tokenization blowup.

ops-ian: note: we still saw a handful of 504s for streaming tails for sessions that were mid-flight during mitigation. support ticket updates sent.

product-maya: collating customer impact: two customers experienced ~7% of requests with stalls; no data loss, just retries and degraded streaming UX. SLA threshold (p99 streaming <1s) was breached for ~12 minutes.

eng-ml-sam: follow-ups (action items):
- revert permanent change to template inline semantics until we have bounding logic (sam, eng-ml)
- add pre-tokenization heuristics: short-circuit if schema > X fields or tokens > Y (rita, ingest)
- add telemetry for template expansion token counts and per-request tokenization time (alex, eng-platform)
- ensure routing rule becomes automated under similar spikes (ops)

oncall-alex: assigning owners. I'll start the postmortem doc and tag infra/eng-ml for deeper analysis.

product-maya: scheduled customer readout tomorrow 11am PT; will include mitigation timeline and expected changes.

eng-ml-sam: quick note: patch to prompt-template to lazy-reference large schemas instead of inlining will be proposed in PR by EOD.

ingest-rita: monitoring dashboard refreshed — no new regressions. keeping alerting sensitivity but lowering noise.

ops-ian: closing page as stable for now. handover to oncall-alex for post-incident tracking. good job team. :thumbsup:

oncall-alex: will maintain watch for 30m then hand to next oncall. creating incident ticket INC-2026-0315 for postmortem and action tracking.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved: preproc tokenizer tail latency — mitigation applied, p99 back under SLO. Next steps: postmortem due in 3 business days.

product-maya: thanks all.
